headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist - radical weight contrast (e.g., Light vs Bold). Tracking tight for large text.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible sans for dense data and controls.

mono.strategy: For credit numbers, AI generation prompts, and technical data points.

accent.purpose: Used specifically for Credit low-balance warnings or premium AI feature triggers.

marketing.strategy: Asymmetrical Bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12), gap-8 to gap-12, high negative space. Use generous padding (p-12 to p-24) for sections.

dashboard.strategy: Dense grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards have p-6.

components.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for structure. Grid borders exposed.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat background (surface_1), 1px border-white/10, no shadow. Hover: border-white/30, slight lift.
surfaces.pricing_cards: The 'Tracing Beam' effect. Neon border accents on the recommended tier.
surfaces.modals: Glassmorphism overlay, solid surface_2 content box, 1px border.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text colors explicitly shift to white. Backgrounds shift to surface_2.
motion_and_interactions.marketing_animations: Scroll-triggered staggered reveals using framer-motion. Parallax on hero images.

landing_page.hero: Outcome-led. Headline explicitly states 'Generate Websites with AI'. Microcopy segmentation. Heavy dark background with subtle abstract light rays. Primary CTA + Social proof directly below.
landing_page.pricing: Hybrid pricing pattern. Clear base subscription + explicit credit mapping (e.g., '1 Credit = 1 Template'). Recommended plan highlighted.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + top header. High contrast data.
dashboard.credit_display: Prominent real-time burn indicator for credits. Add-on purchase button adjacent.
dashboard.generator_ui: Split view: Chat/Prompt input on the left (mono font), live preview skeleton on the right.

images.description: Abstract light rays for hero background overlay. Use with low opacity (10-20%) and blend modes to avoid competing with text.
Graphs and analytics on a screen.
images.usage: Landing page feature section - dashboard preview

images.description: Website template mockup showing the modern way to build for the web.
images.usage: Landing page feature section - AI generation preview

images.description: Futuristic digital interface and data points.
images.usage: Marketing page or Auth page background

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-template-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text on the #0A0A0C background. Action colors must maintain 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'framer-motion' for hero and bento grid animations.
Build the dashboard using pure Tailwind CSS for layout, leveraging Shadcn UI strictly for complex interactive components (Dialog, Select, Tabs).
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for the marketing layout, use raw HTML/Tailwind to allow for asymmetry.
Ensure the credit purchasing flow is clear and distinct from the main subscription tiers.
Apply 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' max to all components for the Swiss Brutalist feel.
